verdict.rationale: Aider's docs show it lints files it edits by default. It can run tests via /test or --auto-test and act on the failures, and the voice docs mention asking it for test cases, so the test-writing and lint-fixing parts of the story are covered. Nothing in the pack addresses resolving merge conflicts or updating dependencies. The only git evidence is auto-commits and raw /git passthrough. Missing for 10: merge-conflict resolution, dependency updating, explicit documentation of lint-error auto-fixing, independent hands-on corroboration.
